title: Two teens, two points of view
objective: Comparer des points de vue dans deux documents courts

steps.title: Warm-up: agree or disagree?
steps.student_instruction: Stand on the agree or disagree side: School uniforms are a good idea. Give one reason.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Débat éclair en ligne de positionnement ; noter au tableau I agree / I disagree / I partly agree.

steps.title: Listening: Important people
steps.student_instruction: Listen to speakers talking about people who matter to them. Compare how two of them see their relationship.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Faire écouter l'audio British Council (QR code) ; sans réseau, lire le script de secours. Faire comparer « avant / maintenant » et les points de vue des locuteurs B, C et D.

steps.title: Reading: Mia and Léo
steps.student_instruction: Read the two texts. Find each argument and the point they both accept.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Tableau à deux colonnes pour / contre ; repérer les marqueurs moreover, however, I disagree with.

steps.title: Differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Complete your A, B or C sheet.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A : classer des arguments ; B : comparer avec both, unlike, whereas ; C : synthèse nuancée et position personnelle.

steps.title: Write and react
steps.student_instruction: Write three sentences: both..., unlike..., I agree with... because... Read them to your group and react.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Observer la reformulation des points de vue (pas de recopie) et le respect des avis contraires.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write one sentence with whereas comparing Mia and Léo.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Ramasser ; vérifier la structure de comparaison.

sheets.student_content: Sort the arguments into FOR uniforms and AGAINST uniforms: nobody judges your clothes / it saves time / clothes show your personality / some students judge others' clothes.
sheets.facilitator_correction: FOR : nobody judges your clothes ; it saves time. AGAINST : clothes show your personality. Point commun : some students judge others' clothes.

sheets.student_content: Write five sentences comparing Mia and Léo with both, unlike, whereas, however and I agree with.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple : Mia likes uniforms whereas Léo prefers his own clothes. Unlike Mia, Léo doesn't wear a uniform. Both think some students judge others' clothes.

sheets.student_content: Write a 120-word synthesis of the two points of view, then give your own opinion with a concession (Even if..., I still think...).
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production libre ; critères : synthèse fidèle des deux documents, comparaison explicite, opinion nuancée.

criteria: L'élève relève les arguments de chaque document
L'élève compare explicitement les points de vue
L'élève exprime son accord ou désaccord avec une raison
